POST /v1/e2ee/devices.description: Every browser or phone makes its own key pair on the device and registers only the public half. The binding signature proves the two public keys belong together and to this account. Private keys never reach the server.

request.label: string, required. A name for the device
request.binding_sig: base64, required. Ed25519 signature by signing_key over `hub/device/v1|` + identity_key + account id

response.label: string. e.g. "Chrome on laptop"
response.identity_key: base64. Public key conversation keys are sealed to
response.signing_key: base64. Public key that verifies this device's signatures
response.fingerprint: string. Short code two people compare to be sure the directory did not swap a key
response.revoked: boolean. true once the device was removed

errors.400: Keys are not valid base64 keys or the binding signature does not verify

devices.signing_key: base64. Public key that verifies this device's signatures

DELETE /v1/e2ee/devices/{id}.description: The device can no longer be sealed keys for. Rotate conversations afterwards if the device was lost.

errors.404: Not your device, or already removed

POST /v1/e2ee/people/devices.summary: Device public keys of many colleagues
POST /v1/e2ee/people/devices.description: One call for a whole group (1 to 5000 people).

request.people: array of uuid, required. Person ids

devices.label: string. e.g. "Chrome on laptop"
devices.identity_key: base64. Public key conversation keys are sealed to
devices.signing_key: base64. Public key that verifies this device's signatures

devices.revoked: boolean. true once the device was removed

PUT /v1/e2ee/backup.description: An opaque blob the client encrypted with a key from the person's passphrase, so a new device can restore their keys. The server cannot open it.

request.kdf: object, required. The key-derivation settings the client needs to reopen it (salt, cost)
